notes.title: Major Update (2025/1/16)
notes.notes:
The game’s save system has been completely transferred from the registry to the game directory! (Future versions will support cloud saves)

In recent days, issues such as save file loss and item loss have caused a poor gaming experience for everyone.

I would like to sincerely apologize to all players for this!

I truly did not anticipate that the built-in save system of the development software would have such significant issues!

I am very regretful that this problem was not resolved during the beta testing phase!

In the upcoming updates, in addition to fixing bugs, I will continue to update new content!

notes.title: 📅 New Release Date: January 10, 2025
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We are very sorry to inform you that we have decided to postpone the release of the game, and here are the reasons:

1. We need to fix the newly discovered critical bugs.
2. The number of wishlists accumulated is not enough at the moment, and we will be doing some promotion during this period.
3. In order to avoid the two Steam sales events in December.

📅 New Release Date: January 10, 2025
On this day, we will present to you a more stable and richer gaming experience.

🎉 Test Version Invitation: Steam Playtest
Since the trial version of the game does not fully reflect the core gameplay, and we also want to collect some player feedback, we plan to launch the complete version of the game for testing from November to December - Steam Playtest. We will inform you of the specific player testing open time through announcements later. If you are interested in becoming a test player, remember to join us then!

💌 Thank you for your patience 💌
We understand that this delay may disappoint some players who have been looking forward to the game, but we assure you that every wait is for the sake of bringing you a better gaming experience. Thank you for every player's understanding and support; your enthusiasm is our driving force.

Please keep a close eye on our official announcements, where we will timely update you on the relevant information about the test version.
